 Petrol, diesel, CNG and LPG prices on November 17 (Image by Reuters) 
 Petrol, diesel prices across India have remained unchanged again today. CNG and LPG prices remain largely unaffected too.
 Brent crude futures were down 0.5% at $92 a barrel in early morning trade, while West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures fell 0.5% to $85.28.
 Story continues below Advertisement 
 Remove Ad 
 "Oil is recalibrating lower as the market increasingly accepts that supply has finally caught up with demand and may now be set to exceed it. That shift in the supply-demand balance is the main factor weighing on prices today," Tim Waterer, chief analyst at KCM Trade told Reuters.
 The world oil market is expected to return to surplus in the fourth quarter, the International Energy Agency said, according to Reuters. This is due to West Asia making a faster than expected recovery despite attacks on shipping.
